scoring_justification: Slopes are recomputed from thermodynamic_curves.csv and compared against required sign/ordering trends; key_quantities.json fields are cross-checked against CSV-extracted values and paper-reported anharmonicity measures.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for a·dB₂D*/da from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text near Fig. 4: 'hydrogenation changes the anharmonicity measure a dB₂D*/da from -6.3 to -13.3 eV Å⁻² for Si and from -18.6 to -13.8 eV Å⁻² for Ge.'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers; the checker uses them as reference with wide tolerance to account for DFT implementation differences.

outputs.description: Temperature-dependent thermodynamic curves. The verifier recomputes temperature slopes of the bulk moduli and verifies trend signs and ordering between systems.
Key aggregated quantities. The verifier compares each value against a hidden reference with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The verifier does not re‑run DFT or SC‑QHA; it only analyses the submitted artifacts.

steps.description: Recompute temperature slopes of B2D, verify trend signs and ordering between systems.
